We tried with SCB, but the OCPP connection was lost. SSH access is required to check the router configuration, and it needs to be done on the XF4 router (customer's router) using a mobile connection only.

Currently XF4 is online & router setting needs to be checked VIA SSH

additional_info.body:
Dear Luca Rizzi,
Thanks for your support and patience, according to our records your issue/query has been resolved for case # 0409748, the case is now closed.
Problem Description
: Change WAN connection to Mobile from Ethernet on XF4 on charger ID
RSVvBQ, JjxZSo
Resolution
: WAN setting has been changed to Mobile from ethernet.
Thanks Giuseppe for your onsite support.
Also I would like to inform, that OCPP connection is much stable on both chargers now.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by submitting a new request at
www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
Kindly note that email responses to closed tickets are not monitored.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Kumar Sharma
